want to set up our towns own ISP, how would this be done?

You'd need a datacenter from which you rent or build at least two backbone connections and connections to your potential customers. Then a team of techies who watch the hardware 24/7, a team for paperwork and one for support.

It usually is the main issue. There are no other big issues.

  1. coordinate with local government for approval in laying out your network
  2. lay out said network
